name: One Oak
acresNote: Planning Commission Motion 19943 (2017): a lot area of about 18,219 sq ft (0.42 acres), Assessor's Block 0836, Lots 001 to 005, on Market Street between Van Ness Avenue and Oak Street.

program.notes: As approved in 2026 (Planning Commission agenda of March 19, 2026; Planning record 2024-005509PRJ): an approximately 508,000 sq ft residential building with 541 homes, a 41-story tower reaching a 400-ft roof (about 416 ft with mechanical equipment and 436 ft with the elevator overrun and rooftop screening) over a 14-story podium about 139 ft tall. 135 parking spaces, three car-share spaces and 210 Class 1 bicycle spaces in three basement levels, plus 27 Class 2 bicycle spaces; a community room, leasing office and lobby on the ground floor. The project would also build a public plaza in part of the Oak Street roadway (Oak Plaza) and enclose the existing Muni station elevator on the site. Planning's record lists all 541 homes as market rate; how the project meets its affordable housing requirement isn't stated in the records read.

stageNote: The Planning Commission approved the current design on March 19, 2026, and the City's height and bulk map now shows the 140-ft podium height limit it needed. No construction permit has been issued; the site permit application on file (2016) is for the 2017 design.

timeline.event: Planning Commission certifies the One Oak EIR (Motion 19938) and approves a 40-story, 400-ft tower with 304 homes (Motions 19943 and 19944).
Planning Commission approves a revised 40-story design, still 400 ft to the roof, with 460 homes (Motions 21139, 21140 and 21141).
Planning publishes an addendum to the 2017 EIR for a further-modified project, finding no new environmental review needed.

Planning Commission approves the modified project: a 41-story tower with a 400-ft roof over a 14-story podium, 541 homes. It also considers the zoning map amendment raising the podium height limit from 120 to 140 ft (Board of Supervisors file 260083).
Planning closes its record of the zoning map amendment as approved; the City's height and bulk map now places the site in the 140/400//140/450-R-4 district.

nextMilestone: A site permit from the Department of Building Inspection for the 2026 design.
summary: A 41-story, 400-ft residential tower with 541 homes on the north side of Market Street at Van Ness Avenue and Oak Street, over a 14-story podium, with a public plaza in the Oak Street roadway. First approved in 2017 and revised in 2022, it was approved in its current, larger form in March 2026.
massingNotes: Added at Matthew's request (2026-10-19); a single-site project below the usual 1,000-home bar. Boundary: DataSF parcels (acdm-wktn), block 0836 lots 001 to 005, the lots the approvals name (about 0.42 acres as drawn). Massing (pipeline/bam_pipeline/sites/massing_one_oak.py): a 400-ft tower and a 139-ft podium on the rest of the lots, the 2026 heights. The tower's outline is the level-14 floor from the plans approved in 2017, registered to the parcel corners (RMS 0.2 m); the 2026 plans couldn't be opened and the 2026 approval enlarged the tower's footprint, so the real tower is wider than drawn. Illustrative, drawn as entitled.
